message.reasoning: We need to navigate to temporary directory. In this environment, we don't know the path. Usually /tmp. We can use pwd to see current. Then cd? There's no cd tool. But we can use ls with path? The ls tool only lists current directory. We can use find? But we need to navigate. There's no tool to change directory. Maybe we can use pwd to see current. Then we can use ls with path? The ls tool signature: ls(a?: boolean). It doesn't accept path. So we can't list arbitrary directory. But maybe we can use find with path? find(path, name). That can search. So we can find all files in /tmp. Use find with path="/tmp". Then list. But we want to list all files including hidden. find will return all. Then we can cat each? But just list names. So we can call find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That returns list. Let's do that.
